# Open MindMap

Open MindMap is a modular React mind map runtime designed for AI-generated and human-edited knowledge structures.
Current site and package target: v0.9.0.

## Primary resources
- Documentation: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/
- Getting started: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/#getting-started
- Markdown syntax: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/#basic-syntax
- AI generation: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/#ai-generation
- Custom styling: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/#custom-styling
- API reference: https://mindmap.u14.app/docs/#api-reference
- Live editor: https://mindmap.u14.app/live/
- Source: https://github.com/u14app/mindmap
- npm: @xiangfa/mindmap

## Runtime entries
- @xiangfa/mindmap/core - parser, serializer, layout, patch controller, streaming, standalone SVG generation
- @xiangfa/mindmap/static - non-interactive React SVG rendering
- @xiangfa/mindmap/viewer - read-only pan, zoom, fit, selection, and accessible semantic tree
- @xiangfa/mindmap/editor - base editing surface and feature host

## Optional features
history, search, import, export, markdown-editor, and ai are independent subpath exports with independent stylesheets.

## Documentation map
The documentation is one long-form page with stable anchors for getting started,
syntax, formatting, links and images, remarks, comments, tasks, Extensions, AI,
styling, API reference, keyboard shortcuts, and utility functions.
